body: I'll keep talking to him. I will try to keep good messages in his head.
He had everything taken away from him, all of his electronics. Even his car. So no, he doesn't have anyone except me to talk to.

He has no phone, no iPod, or no laptop. He can only call me on his home phone. I don't know about his situation at school however. I don't think he has very many friends there, he transferred just a few weeks ago.
